_comment: Copy this file to shortlist.json and replace the interventions below with those shortlisted from the Phase 1 evidence review. Each entry needs a 'name' (used in PubMed [tiab] + OpenAlex + registry matching). 'synonyms' and 'mesh' are optional and broaden the CEA search; 'population' is informational only. Avoid ambiguous short synonyms (e.g. 'VAS' also means Visual Analog Scale) — they cause topical false positives in OpenAlex's free-text CEA search.
